a.label: RustSHT-FFT M25 radix-11 ido=1 AVX2 candidate

metadata.candidate_source_base: M24 source commit 9a85e38, plus the M25 source patch identified by SHA-256
metadata.code_layout_note: The ido=1 helper is out of line from execute_radix11_avx2. The latter has the same 0x0b7c-byte symbol size as M24, avoiding growth in the common ido>=2 function.
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime SIMD dispatch
metadata.dispatch_note: The candidate applies an AVX2 f64 radix-11 kernel to ido=1 passes with l1>=2, vectorizing pairs of outer groups. Odd outer tails and unsafe inverse inputs use the scalar path. f32 and CPUs without AVX2 retain the general scalar pass.
metadata.pre_capture_host_condition: No SHT or FFT benchmark process observed at 2026-10-16T06:42:47Z; the separate M1 SHT baseline/candidate process had terminated. Load-average telemetry was retained only in local diagnostics.
metadata.purpose: Refactored M25 AVX2 radix-11 ido=1 candidate against the M24 binary across the complete 34-cell SHT target matrix; replacement for the diagnostic first capture
metadata.runner: Load-average telemetry was retained only in local diagnostics.
metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.workload: All current exact C2C and real SHT target operation/length cells; scalar and spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
